samples.question: Two small tracking registers are far apart, one at the top-left corner and one at the bottom-right corner of the canvas, and the white space between them is empty. Each register has one coloured start dot (blue = tracked state OFF, orange = tracked state ON) plus a cluster of red toggle dots that invert that register's own tracked state, once per red dot. Track each register's state independently, then bind the two distant registers together by comparing them. Do both tracked states end up equal? Answer yes or no.
